subject: RE: Mutual Action Plan — legal redlines / MSA & DPA ownership and turnaround
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Tom Huang <tom.huang@acme.com>, Jane O'Leary <jane.oleary@acme.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call: MAP draft and next steps (legal redlines milestone)

Hi Tom / Jane —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap and our proposed Mutual Action Plan (attached) to keep us aligned on milestones and owners. Key items for legal:

- Milestone: MSA / DPA redlines completed and agreed
  - Owner: Acme legal (primary), Redwood legal (counterparty)
  - Target close date: 2026-11-18 (we're estimating 2 weeks for initial redlines review + 1 week for back-and-forth)
  - Dependencies: Acme to send initial redlines; Redwood to confirm any high-priority terms within 3 business days of receiving redlines

Attachments: Redwood-MAP-draft.xlsx, Redwood-MSA-draft.docx (MSA baseline)

Proposed turnaround expectations: initial redlines from Acme by 2026-11-06; Redwood legal to review and provide comments within 3 business days; where escalation is needed, loop in Vivek for SLA/term exceptions.

Next steps:
1) Jane/Tom — confirm who will be the point of contact on Acme legal and whether procurement will own commercial terms or legal will handle (reply by EOD 2026-11-04).
2) If you can send your redlines, please attach as a Word doc and indicate any absolute no-go items.
3) Rafael and I will prepare the MAP with milestones updated once we have your expected redline delivery date.

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0112

--
Redwood Inference | Developer-first inference platform

From: Jane O'Leary <jane.oleary@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Tom Huang <tom.huang@acme.com>
Cc: Acme Legal <legal@acme.com>
Date: 2026-11-03T09:23:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: MAP draft and next steps (legal redlines milestone)

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the recap and draft MAP. Acme legal will take the lead on the MSA & DPA redlines. Quick notes:

- We expect to produce initial redlines by 2026-11-06 as discussed, assuming no new material terms are introduced during commercial review.
- Our legal team will mark any required changes and flag any SLA/KPI items that need business sign-off.
- Primary point of contact for legal: Jane O'Leary (me). Procurement point of contact (for commercial terms) will be Tom Huang — I will coordinate internally if we need him to act earlier.

One ask: can Redwood confirm who will own edits on the MSA vs DPA? If Acme sends redlines in Word tracked changes, do you prefer Redwood to accept and re-issue a redline version, or will Redwood counter in Word? Helps us set expectations on turnaround.

Attaching: ACME-Redlines-v1.docx (initial internal notes) — note it's internal; we'll send a formal redline to Redwood legal by 11/06.

Best,
Jane
Legal Counsel | Acme Corp

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jane O'Leary <jane.oleary@acme.com>, Tom Huang <tom.huang@acme.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-03T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: MAP draft and next steps (legal redlines milestone)

Jane — perfect, thanks. Short answers on process so we can call this out explicitly on the MAP: 

- Ownership of edits: Acme sends tracked redlines (Word) to Redwood legal. Redwood legal (Laura) will do an initial review and return a tracked-counter with comments. We are fine with either workflow, but to keep a single source of truth we prefer: Acme sends redlines -> Redwood reviews and counters in Word -> iterative tracked-changes exchange.
- Turnaround SLAs: Redwood legal will aim to review initial redlines within 3 business days. If there are Tier-1 objections (data residency, access to logs, indemnity), we'll flag them within 1 business day and propose a parallel sync call.

I'll update the MAP to reflect: Acme (send redlines by 2026-11-06); Redwood legal review within 3 business days; escalation to Vivek for exceptions.

Rafael/Vivek/Laura — adding you here so internal owners are clear. Laura, can you confirm the 3-business-day review SLA and whether Redwood's legal prefers we own the DocuSign flow or leave that to Ops?

Thanks — Marissa

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-04T10:00:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: MAP draft and next steps (legal redlines milestone)

Marissa / team —

Confirming Redwood legal's approach and internal assignment:

- Redwood ownership: Laura Bennett (Legal) will be primary reviewer for MSA/DPA redlines. My team will produce a tracked-counter in Word within 3 business days of receiving Acme's redline doc. For critical items (data residency, data processing terms, indemnity caps), we'll flag within 1 business day and propose fallback language.
- DocuSign flow: Redwood Ops (contracts@redwood.com) will manage final DocuSign envelope once terms are agreed. Redwood legal will not send envelopes; we will route final approved doc to Ops to execute. Please note: if Acme requires Redwood to initiate DocuSign for procurement reasons, we can accommodate but need 24-hour notice.
- Escalation contacts: Vivek (sales lead) for commercial/SLA exceptions; Rafael for renewal/discount approvals.

I'll draft a one-page checklist to attach to the MAP that spells out owners and the SLA/timelines. ETA for that checklist: EOD 2026-11-04.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Tom/Jane — attaching the updated MAP (Redwood-MAP-draft.xlsx) which now includes:

- Milestone: MSA & DPA redlines — Acme to send tracked redlines (Word) by 2026-11-06
- Redwood legal review SLA: 3 business days from receipt; critical-item flag within 1 business day
- DocuSign flow: Redwood Ops will manage final signing unless Acme requests Redwood to initiate (24-hour notice)
- Escalation path: Vivek for commercial exceptions; Rafael for discount/renewal approvals; Laura is primary counterparty for legal comments

Please confirm the 11/06 redline delivery target or let us know an alternative date. Once we have your redlines we'll update the MAP milestone target-close-date (currently 2026-11-18) based on the volume of changes.

Thanks and looking forward to your confirmation —
Marissa
